easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures, one of which must have Dissection Tools attached to it.
description:
Activate Dissection Tools' equip ability by sacrificing the creature it is attached to, targeting another creature you control.
When the creature dies, Guardian of the Forgotten triggers, causing you to manifest the top card of your library.
Resolve the Dissection Tools trigger, attaching it to the targeted creature.
Repeat.
